scope: All 21 reserved INFO field IDs in VCFv4.1-4.5. SV-specific INFO definitions outside the reserved INFO table are handled in the SV semantic crosswalk and are not falsely represented as rows in table VCF5.3.
method: For each INFO row, retain exact version-specific source line, representation, Number/Type where specified and description; record all mechanical row changes; attach the VCFv4.5 row semantic note and field interpretation. This completes author row-level interpretation of the reserved INFO table but not independent review or all SV INFO clause mappings.
